head: ʕtrf (< Arab. ʕrf (VIII) cf. Wehr 831: gestehen, eingestehen, zugeben, bekennen;)

examples.turoyo: məd ḥzele l-u=malaxo <…> d-tayəb w-məʕtarafle b-aloho, šləḥle aǧ=ǧul-ayḏe w-hiwile l-u=moro
examples.translation: As the angel saw that he had [truly] repented and had professed God he took off his clothes and gave them back to [their] owner
examples.raw: məd ḥzele l-u=malaxo <…> d-tayəb w-məʕtarafle b-aloho, šləḥle aǧ=ǧul-ayḏe w-hiwile l-u=moro ‘As the angel saw that he had [truly] repented and had professed God he took off his clothes and gave them back to [their] owner’; [MT]; 807; 43/43;

examples.turoyo: hano u=malko zlām mhayəmno-wa, w-kul yawmo d-ḥušabo əzze-wa l-i=ʕito, w-məʕtaraf-wa, w-šoqal-wa qurbono
examples.translation: This king was a devout man and every Sunday he went to the church, confessed and received communion
examples.raw: hano u=malko zlām mhayəmno-wa, w-kul yawmo d-ḥušabo əzze-wa l-i=ʕito, w-məʕtaraf-wa, w-šoqal-wa qurbono ʻThis king was a devout man and every Sunday he went to the church, confessed and received communionʼ; 807; 47/54; [MT]
